FN-VBIKLP-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 258
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/02/2023
Senate Bill 258 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Examiners of Public Accounts by an undetermined amount to conduct audits or examinations of
certain public water service providers. However, any increase in obligations could be offset,
wholly or in part, by reasonable fees charged by the Department, as authorized by the provisions
of this bill.

FN-VBIKLP-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 258
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/17/2023
Senate Bill 258 as reported by the Committee on State Government could increase the
administrative obligations of the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts by an
undetermined amount to conduct audits or examinations of certain nonprofit water service
providers. However, any increase in obligations could be offset, wholly or in part, by reasonable
fees charged by the Department, as authorized by the provisions of this bill.
